title: Mister Kooks 2002-2013
content: I'm sad to report that our parakeet Mr. Kooks has died. At more than 11 years of age, he was rather old for a budgie, but still as cheerful as ever until the end.He was always glad to leave his cage to sit on my shoulder as I painted, or to hang out on his perch-playground. He starred in my videoParakeet Artist,and often posed for an impromptu portrait, such as the one in oil above.
